q: What is a white-label essential oil diffuser?
a: It is a diffuser designed by a specialist and sold under your brand’s name. With Tolia, Innobiz adapts the colour, finishes, logo, box and diffusion modes to your brand, typically from 3,000 units. To start faster, Tolia is also available from stock, from 500 units.

q: Can we use our own essential oils?
a: Yes, your whole range: the module screws onto standard 5, 10, 15, 30 or 50 ml bottles (DIN 18 neck), without removing the dropper, with no decanting and nothing to fill.

q: Which oils and fragrances can Tolia diffuse?
a: Every essential oil on the market: our exclusive technology has been tested on more than 150 essential oils and blends. It also diffuses natural fragrances and synthetic home fragrances.
Yes. Tolia diffuses pure essential oil, with no water and no heat: there is no tank to fill or clean, and the oil keeps its full scent.

q: How long does Tolia’s battery last?
a: Up to 90 hours of battery life: 70 to 90 h with the light off, 16 to 20 h with the ambient light on, depending on intensity. The battery charges via USB‑C, and users can replace it themselves.

q: Can we control how our oils are used?
a: Yes. Diffusion duration, strength and on/off cycles can be pre-programmed to your recommendations, and diffusion stops by itself after the chosen time.

q: What brings customers back to your oils rather than a competitor’s?
a: The DIN 18 neck is a standard, so another brand’s bottle can be screwed on too. What brings customers back to your oils is everything that carries your brand: the diffuser and its modules in your colours, diffusion modes pre-programmed to your recommendations, a user manual and a QR code to your loyalty programme, and your oils, which they already know.
